read.thesis: Schwab's record Q2 (revenue $7.1B, up 21%; adjusted EPS $1.62, up 42%) is demand-driven with no supply-side signal; lending and long-short drive NIM and the FY26 revenue guide rises to 17.5–18.5%.

triggers.label: FY26 revenue growth 17.5%–18.5%
triggers.quote: we would expect total revenue growth of 17.5%-18.5% in 2026

triggers.label: Record June NNA $62.7B
triggers.quote: including a record $62.7 billion in June which reflected an annualized organic growth rate of 5.8%

triggers.label: Expense growth raised to 9.5%–10.5%
triggers.quote: we now anticipate annual expense growth to range from 9.5%-10.5%

guidance.quote: we would expect total revenue growth of 17.5%-18.5% in 2026
we now anticipate annual expense growth to range from 9.5%-10.5%
we have taken full-year daily average trades up to 10.6 million
an average 4Q 2026 net interest margin expected to finish in the 3.25%-330% range
Our asset gathering momentum reinforces our confidence in the 5% organic growth rate we outlined for 2026.

prior_guidance_check.quote: Our asset gathering momentum reinforces our confidence in the 5% organic growth rate we outlined for 2026.
underlying expenses still remain in line with the 5.5%-6.5% range we shared at the January winter business update

red_flags.label: Record trading may not sustain
red_flags.quote: indicating that second quarter record volumes may not be sustained in the near term

evasions.quote: That activity has been somewhat subdued this year. For our outlook, we assume that it will remain somewhat subdued.
we'll always look at our capabilities. We look at scale, we never rule anything out.
